The lower-left rectangle is labeled with side lengths 8 cm and 10 cm, and its non-overlapping part is colored black; the upper-right rectangle is labeled with side lengths 9 cm and 12 cm, and its non-overlapping part is colored gray; the middle white part is the common overlapping region of the two rectangles.
